E1.evidence: The report is a code-level statement of one concrete mismatch with links to both sides: "Since ArduPlane-3.7.0, mode 14, previously assigned to LAND, has changed to AVOID_ADSB." and "This does not match the stringify for ArduPlane in mavros lib, for both ROS2 and ROS1" -- https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/2048 . The maintainer merged the fixes (PR #2049, "Fix #2048"; PR #2050, "Fix #2049 for ROS2") and closed the issue: "Thank you for the contribution!" -- https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/2048#issuecomment-3062531029

E2.evidence: mavros (ROS node/library) and the ArduPlane firmware are separately released units that interact over MAVLink. The value of the custom_mode field crossing that boundary is interpreted differently on the two sides for value 14: mavros maps it to "LAND" ("{ 14, "LAND" },		// not in list" -- https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/1.20.1/mavros/src/lib/uas_stringify.cpp), ArduPlane declares "AVOID_ADSB    = 14," (https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/blob/ArduPlane-3.7.0/ArduPlane/defines.h). mavros converts mode strings to custom_mode for SET_MODE ("if (!m_uas->cmode_from_str(req.custom_mode, custom_mode)) {" and "sm.custom_mode = custom_mode;" in mavros/src/plugins/sys_status.cpp at 1.20.1) and HEARTBEAT custom_mode back to strings ("auto vehicle_mode = m_uas->str_mode_v10(hb.base_mode, hb.custom_mode);"). Not internal, not a name binding, not build-only; the firmware is not at fault and its mode enumeration is declared.

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: the provider (ArduPlane) assigned mode number 14 in ArduPlane-3.7.0, while mavros's ArduPlane table still reflects the provider's mode list from before that release (entries 0-8, 10-12, 15-21 as in ArduPlane-3.6.0, with 14 marked "not in list"). The failing exchange itself would be a PAIR (mavros sends SET_MODE / reads HEARTBEAT).

E4.evidence: Code-level statement of the mismatch and its predicted effect, not an observation: "could result in unwanted behaviors if the user asks for LAND mode using mavros, which would translate to a request for the flight controller to change to AVOID_ADSB mode." -- https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/2048 . No observed flight or log is reported, so outcome class undocumented.

failed_conditions.quote: Since ArduPlane-3.7.0, mode 14, previously assigned to LAND, has changed to AVOID_ADSB.

loudness_evidence: No execution is reported; the effect is only predicted: "could result in unwanted behaviors if the user asks for LAND mode using mavros" -- https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/2048

resolution.summary: mavros's ArduPlane custom-mode table maps 14 to "AVOID_ADSB" instead of "LAND" (PR #2049 on master for ROS1, PR #2050 on the ros2 branch). ArduPlane is unchanged.
resolution.evidence: Merged as a5c9f963b0bc0490ec41092de92927a539352d69 (master) and e7a3e40e55f57e7b70d16b029f4cea37a1e971cf (ros2); no test or flight with ArduPlane is shown in the issue or PRs.

notes: Composition chosen: the ROS1 line (mavros master / tag 1.20.1), which the reporter links with an exact tag and which PR #2049 ("Fix #2048") fixes; the identical mismatch in the ROS2 line (ros2 branch, mavros/src/lib/uas_stringify.cpp: "{14, "LAND"},                 // not in list", fixed by PR #2050, merge e7a3e40e55f57e7b70d16b029f4cea37a1e971cf) is a second composition not specified here. consumer_built_against is inferred: mavros's table (header comment "ArduPlane/defines.h") lists exactly the modes of ArduPlane-3.6.0's enum FlightMode (0-8, 10-12, 15-21) plus 14 marked "not in list"; ArduPlane-3.7.0 differs from 3.6.0 in the enum only by adding AVOID_ADSB = 14. The resolved table (with 14 = AVOID_ADSB) matches ArduPlane-3.7.0's enum exactly. Primary-source correction of the reporter's wording "previously assigned to LAND": ArduPlane's own defines.h never had an active LAND mode; up to ArduPlane-2.67 it carried the commented placeholder "//#define LAND 14			// This is not used by APM.", and from 2.68 to 3.6.0 value 14 is absent from enum FlightMode. The classes follow the fix diff's framing of the change as a rename of the enumerator for value 14 ("renamed, prev name: LAND"), applying the rule for a renamed element inside a definition (definition_mismatch + element_retyped); the same mismatch could also be read as representation_convention (the integer custom_mode encodes different modes on the two sides). 'api:FlightMode' names ArduPlane's mode enumeration as declared at ArduPlane-3.7.0 (ArduPlane/defines.h); on current master it is Mode::Number in ArduPlane/mode.h. Current master also has modes 13 TAKEOFF and 22-26 that mavros's table lacks; they are outside the 3.6.0 -> 3.7.0 upgrade specified here.
